items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So, he suggested Milwaukee... I was fortunate enough through this same Burke Bailey to... leave there. So the last ... Burke had another job across the river.

ctx.x: Yeah, we're out of Minneapolis. We played the Dakotas, we played North and South Dakota, Iowa, Nebraska, see what I mean? ... all those bands, you know. So, it got out of hand. I didn't see anything was happening there so I decided to risk making it. So I went to Milwaukee. Oh, Burke Bailey, I must tell you about Burke Bailey. Burke Bailey I always thought he was a tremendous musician and lot of things I don't think happened TO Burke Bailey. Another fellow by the name of Norman Mason So, I who decided to go to…
